stemBlocks:
The variation of the acceleration with time of an object moving in a straight line is shown on the graph.
At time $= 0\text{s}$ the velocity of the object is $8.0\text{ ms}^{-1}$.
What is the maximum velocity of the object between time $= 0\text{s}$ and time $= 6\text{ s}$?

assets.alt: Graph showing acceleration / $\text{m s}^{-2}$ vs time / $\text{s}$. The acceleration starts at 4.0 $\text{m s}^{-2}$ at time 0 $\text{s}$ and decreases linearly to 0 $\text{m s}^{-2}$ at time 6.0 $\text{s}$.
